title: Restrict QA and task-order agents to read-only + task file creation
description:
The QA improvement agent and task-order agent currently have tools: ['*'] which gives them full write access to all source files. They should be restricted so they can only READ code and CREATE/MODIFY files in the tasks/ folder (plus IMPROVEMENTS.md for the QA agent). This ensures they can safely run alongside the developer agent on the same branch without risk of conflicting code modifications.

Implementation:
1. In qa-improvement-agent.json, replace "tools": ["*"] with an explicit allowlist that includes read tools (read_file, read_files, read_code, grep_search, file_search, list_directory), fs_write/str_replace scoped via a PreToolUse hook to only allow writes to tasks/*.json and IMPROVEMENTS.md, and web/browser tools for research.
2. In task-order-agent.json, replace "tools": ["*"] with an explicit allowlist that includes read tools and fs_write/str_replace scoped via hook to only allow writes to tasks/*.json (rename and priority updates).
3. Create a PreToolUse hook that blocks write operations (fs_write, str_replace, fs_append, delete_file) when the target path is outside the allowed set for these agents.
4. Alternatively, use the 'allowedTools' field in the agent JSON configs if it supports path-based scoping, or rely on prompt-level instructions as a softer guardrail if hook-based enforcement is too complex for the hackathon.

Minimal approach (if hooks are too complex): Update the agent prompts to explicitly state 'You MUST NOT modify any file outside tasks/ and IMPROVEMENTS.md' and remove dangerous tools from the tools array, keeping only: read_file, read_files, read_code, grep_search, file_search, list_directory, fs_write, str_replace, execute_pwsh (for Puppeteer in QA agent), web_fetch, remote_web_search.
